Interface ItemScope

public interface ItemScope
Tracks the item a collection, array, or map conversion is working on, so a failure can name it.

Each item is entered before it converts and exited after, whether or not it failed; a failure passes through fail(boolean, RuntimeException) while the item is still entered.
